blocks.text: Carboxylic acids aise organic compounds hain jin mein carboxyl functional group, -COOH, ho; aam formula RCOOH hai. Aam misalein methanoic acid (formic acid, cheentiyon mein), ethanoic acid (acetic acid, sirke mein) aur butanoic acid (butyric acid, basi makhan mein) hain.

Chhote carboxylic acids kamre ke darja hararat par oonche ubalne ke darjon wale maaye hain, kyunke in ke molecules hydrogen bonds banate hain; ethanoic acid ke molecules hydrogen bond wale joron (dimers) mein jurte hain. Ethanoic acid 17 C par pighalta aur 118 C par ubalta hai. Is ka pighalne ka darja kamre ke darje ke qareeb hai, is liye sardiyon mein jam jata hai; khalis ethanoic acid ki thos shakal glacial acetic acid kehlati hai kyunke yeh glacier jaisi dikhti hai. Paani se hydrogen bonds banane ki wajah se chhote tezaab, methanoic aur ethanoic acid, paani mein ghulte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: carboxyl group, aik carbon jis par C=O aur -OH, aur R. Daen: ethanoic acid ke do molecules aamne saamne, har aik ke C=O oxygen se doosre ke O-H tak do dashed hydrogen bonds.
blocks.caption: Carboxyl group aur ethanoic acid ka hydrogen bond wala dimer (kitab ke dimer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Carboxyl group aik hi carbon par carbonyl group aur hydroxyl group jorta hai. Aik molecule ka O-H hydrogen doosre ke C=O oxygen ki taraf khinchta hai, is liye do molecules do hydrogen bonds se aik doosre ko thaamte hain; inhein alag karne ko izafi tawanai chahiye, jis se ubalne ka darja ooncha hota hai.

blocks.text: Lambi zanjeer wale aliphatic monocarboxylic acids fatty acids kehlate hain. Stearic, palmitic aur oleic acids nabati teilon mein triglycerides ki shakal mein hain; palmitic acid, C16H32O2, palm oil mein bari miqdar mein hai. Fatty acids apni lambi hydrophobic (paani se door bhagne wali) alkyl zanjeeron ki wajah se paani mein nahi ghulte.

blocks.prompt: Ethanoic acid ka ubalne ka darja ethanal se kaheen zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid ke molecules apne -OH aur C=O groups se hydrogen bonds (dimers) banate hain; ethanal mein O-H nahi aur yeh khud se hydrogen bond nahi bana sakta.

items: Carboxylic acids: RCOOH; maslan methanoic, ethanoic, butanoic acids.
Hydrogen bond wale dimers: oonche ubalne ke darje; chhote tezaab paani mein ghulte.
Fatty acids: lambi zanjeerein, paani mein na ghulne wale.
